entries.title: Tirawa (crater)
entries.extract: Tirawa is the largest impact basin on Saturn's moon Rhea. It was glimpsed by Voyager 1 during its flyby of the moon and later photographed in greater detail by the Cassini orbiter. Tirawa is elongated in shape and overlaps Mamaldi, a larger and more degraded basin to its southwest.

entries.title: Inktomi (crater)
entries.extract: 3 mi) in diameter located in the southern hemisphere of Saturn's moon Rhea.1 W. Inktomi is thought to be the youngest major surface feature on Rhea, with estimates ranging from 8 to 280 million years.

entries.title: Pulag Chasma
entries.extract: Pulag Chasma is a deep cliff or graben on Rhea, the second largest moon of planet Saturn.

entries.title: Vaupas Chasma
entries.extract: Vaupas Chasma is a chasmata on Rhea, a moon of Saturn. The chasma was named after the Vaupés River flowing through Colombia and Brazil, officially approved by the International Astronomical Union (IAU) on 6 August 2010.
